sections.title: Physical appearance: Small to modestly sized amphibious people, usually about one to four feet tall, with sinewy limbs,
sections.text:
Physical appearance: Small to modestly sized amphibious people, usually about one to four feet tall, with sinewy limbs,
damp protective skin, webbed hands and feet, and often a powerful prehensile tail. Sensory fins or
frills can frame the head. Large reflective eyes, color-shifting patterns, and luminous markings
permit both speech and visual expression. They can move upright or on four limbs; moisture is
essential to their health.

Physical appearance: Tall, slender, graceful magic-dependent humanoids with features that vary markedly among bloodlines.
Skin may range from pale ivory through earth green and brown to deep sapphire. Eyes glow faintly in
the color of their affinity, while fine hair can shimmer or float in dense ambient magic. Appearance
should communicate personal lineage, not a single uniform skin color.

sections.title: Physical appearance: Aza'raans are generally tall, slender and graceful, with long limbs and a very pale to slightly tanned complexion.
sections.text: Physical appearance: Aza'raans are generally tall, slender and graceful, with long limbs and a very pale to slightly tanned complexion. The usual unmixed skin-color range resembles fair to lightly tanned complexions seen among Italian, Slavic and Balkan human populations, without implying any shared Earth ethnic identity. Copper, deep copper, auburn and dark auburn are the most common hair colors. Brown appears sometimes, while black and blonde are rare. Silver, blue and green eyes are common, often with a distinctly oceanic shape, occasionally dual-toned or subtly reflective. High oceanic-style cheekbones, a slightly angular brow with shallow paired ridges, and long ears swept backward are defining traits. Ear tips range from moderately pointed to dramatically sharp and elongated, with individual variation. Some Aza'raans bear faint freckles, subtle psionic luminescence, or wave-like ritual markings. Kaluseban, Deorbasun, Zirramunis, Iamhazira and Gandirosha ancestry can introduce additional color, stature, ear, hair, eye, animal-associated, or magical characteristics; such variation does not redefine the typical unmixed appearance.

sections.title: * Aza’raan with Kaluseban ancestry: Kalus’aan is the established name for this mixed-ancestry community. Their Aza’raan cranial ridges,
sections.text:
* Aza’raan with Kaluseban ancestry: Kalus’aan is the established name for this mixed-ancestry community. Their Aza’raan cranial ridges,
slender limbs, silver, blue, or green eyes and copper-to-auburn hair may mingle with Kaluseban color
shifts, luminous marks, mineral textures, water-adapted accents, or forest and shadow features. The
six documented Kalus’aan expressions are Arcane, Starborne, Wildroot, Tideborn, Stonebound, and
Umbral; they are not six separate species. Appearance differs with the family and the particular
Kaluseban bloodline.

sections.title: * Aza’raan with Deorbasun ancestry: An Aza’raan descendant of a Deorbasun family may keep pale-to-lightly-tanned Aza’raan skin and
sections.text:
* Aza’raan with Deorbasun ancestry: An Aza’raan descendant of a Deorbasun family may keep pale-to-lightly-tanned Aza’raan skin and
auburn or copper hair while expressing more pronounced reflective eyes, feline or other soul-animal
hints, a heavier mane, unusual ear contours, tail, fur patches, claw-like nails, or rare wing
features. The Deorbasun soul-animal bond is individually expressed and cannot be assigned a standard
animal or fixed bloodline by appearance alone. No separate canonical community name has been
established.

sections.title: * Aza’raan with Zirramunis ancestry: These descendants may be shorter or more densely built than a typical Aza’raan, with strong
sections.text:
* Aza’raan with Zirramunis ancestry: These descendants may be shorter or more densely built than a typical Aza’raan, with strong
forearms, compact musculature, prominent bone structure, mineral-glinting eyes, stone-colored accent
markings, and thick hair or beard growth. Copper and dark auburn hair and the silver, blue, or green
Aza’raan eye spectrum can persist, with jeweled or metallic notes from Zirramunis heritage. No
distinct mixed-species name or special fixed subtype is confirmed.

sections.title: * Aza’raan with Iamhazira ancestry: The historically documented Aza’zira community blends Aza’raan facial proportions, psionic markings
sections.text:
* Aza’raan with Iamhazira ancestry: The historically documented Aza’zira community blends Aza’raan facial proportions, psionic markings,
and reflective eyes with Iamhazira height, powerful musculature, endurance traits, braids, strong
jaw structure, and sometimes tusk features. Complexion may extend beyond the unmixed pale-to-
lightly-tanned baseline where that parental lineage is visible. Individuals may retain copper or
auburn hair, or express their Iamhazira family’s tones and scar or ornament customs.

sections.title: * Aza’raan with Gandirosha ancestry: These descendants can retain the typical pale or lightly tanned Aza’raan complexion, copper or
sections.text:
* Aza’raan with Gandirosha ancestry: These descendants can retain the typical pale or lightly tanned Aza’raan complexion, copper or
auburn hair and silver, blue, or green eyes, while expressing greater agility, a more compact or
lithe build, freckles that resemble luminous sigils, more mobile facial expression, or colorful hair
highlights associated with Gandirosha ancestry. These are variable family traits, not a separate
named species or mandatory personality features.

Physical appearance: Very tall, heavily muscled people built for endurance. Skin ranges from charcoal gray and ochre to
muted green, with scars or war paint carrying personal histories. Tusks may bear rings or carvings.

battle-nicked. No current source supplies an approved biological bloodline list.

sections.title: Pix family appearance canon: Pix is a transgender man who can pass as human despite his visibly pointed, backward-swept ears. The child
sections.text: Pix family appearance canon: Pix is a transgender man who can pass as human despite his visibly pointed, backward-swept ears. The childhood name 'Pix' came from those conspicuous ears, which his parents explained as an old inherited abnormality. Pix and his father have the tell-tale pointed ears. Pix's mother, Jacob and Clarahmizah have ordinary-looking human ears without points. Pix's mother eventually explains that much of the protector bloodline shared by her and Clarahmizah has Gandirosha and Zirramunis ancestry, and many descendants lost the conspicuous Aza'raan ear shape. Pix inherited the unmistakable ears through his father. The absence of pointed ears does not erase anyone's Aza'raan lineage or protector heritage.
